input.subject: Natural Sciences
learningObjectives: Describe the stages of the water cycle.
Explain how energy from the sun drives evaporation.

expectations.criterion: The brief describes a visual that clearly illustrates at least two stages of the water cycle (e.g. evaporation, condensation, precipitation). The pedagogicalPurpose states which concept a learner should understand better after seeing the image. Brief text is specific enough for an artist to execute without additional instruction.

rubric: Grade 4 NS water cycle visual brief: stages visible, pedagogicalPurpose present and concept-focused, no fabricated facts, at least one citation.

input.subject: Mathematics

rubric: Equivalent fractions area model diagram brief; pedagogicalPurpose names equivalence; grade 7 appropriate complexity.

rubric: Foundation Phase phonics visual; Grade 2 appropriate imagery; objects with short /a/ sound; simple and colourful brief.
